stem: A recurring pest hotspot appears beside an exterior door after each delivery day. What is the strongest long-term response?
choices: Treat only the hotspot repeatedly without investigating the pattern
Move sticky cards away from the door so counts decrease
Stop recording the location because the pattern is already known
Investigate entry pathways and delivery practices, strengthen exclusion and sanitation, and continue monitoring the hotspot
rationale: A repeatable spatial and timing pattern suggests an introduction pathway. Addressing exclusion and workflow causes is more durable than repeatedly treating symptoms alone.
